integrity: Analytical proofs and finite independent symbolic/numerical checks only; no independent external audit, publication verification or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive harmonic drift and noise, independent positive-rate Poisson clock, constant contraction 0<=q<1; asymptotics are at fixed q and are not uniform as q tends to one. Related models with stochastic stiffness or non-Poisson timing are outside scope.
